Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Theodoric the Great was “from Germany,” conflating his Germanic (Ostrogothic) ethnicity with the modern nation-state. Britannica confirms he was king of the Ostrogoths and ruled Italy (Ostrogothic Kingdom with capital at Ravenna); it does not support “Germany” as his country of origin. This erroneous leap produced the wrong final answer.
